slides.title: Programs need memory
slides.text: A variable is a named box that holds a value while the program runs. The program can read it and change it.
slides.alt: A Pro variables level: the program keeps a number in a box named x, and changes x by 1 for every gem Bolt picks up.

focus.cue: This program's box is named x. What does x hold? The name does not say.
x goes up by 1 for every gem Bolt picks up.

slides.title: Names are for people
slides.text: The computer is happy with x. The person reading your program is not. A name like count says exactly what the box holds.
slides.alt: The same program with a better name: set count to 0, then change count by 1 for every gem, seven times.

focus.cue: Same program, better name: count says what it holds.
change count by 1 reads like a sentence.

slides.title: Boxes have types
slides.text: A number box counts. A flag box (a Boolean) is on or off, like hasKey. A word box holds one word from a list, like color. Pick the type that fits.
slides.alt: A flag box: set hasKey to Off, and inside the loop, if there is something to pick up, pick it up and set hasKey to On.

focus.cue: hasKey is a flag box: it starts Off.
The if asks first: is there something to pick up here?
The flag box shows here: Off until Bolt picks up the key.

slides.title: Watch the value
slides.text: Set puts a value in. Change by adds to what is there, and a negative number takes away. Two rounds into the repeat, steps is 6 - 1 - 1 = 4.
slides.alt: Two rounds into repeat 6, the watch strip reads steps = 4: set steps to 6 started it, and each change steps by -1 brings it down.

focus.cue: Each change by -1 takes one away.
Repeat 6 runs the change 6 times. Two rounds in, steps is 4.

words.means: a named box that holds a value
the kind of value: a number, a flag or a word
a flag that is only true or false, on or off
add a number (or take one away) from the value

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Variables and finish all 6 levels, so you meet the on/off flag. When the shelf offers names, pick the one a partner would understand.
slides.alt: A Pro variables level: the program keeps a number in a box named x, and changes x by 1 for every gem Bolt picks up.

focus.cue: Your turn: pick names a partner would understand.
